svg.title: Hoffman–Martín–White ray-avoiding surface topology
svg.desc: Original compact construction schematics: a rounded cubical shell with six radial passages and genus five, a cutaway revealing its inner wall, and a sevenfold polygonal shell of genus six. These are not computed self-shrinkers. Compactness of the tangent shrinkers is not asserted.

g.text: A surface around the excluded rays
Inner and outer walls join at each opening
Each excluded ray passes through an opening into the central cavity without meeting the surface.
Two spheres with q disks removed, joined along q rims, give genus q − 1.
SCHEMATIC · no shrinker equation or mean curvature flow has been solved
These compact models illustrate the construction input. The resulting shrinkers need not be compact.
